Attaining [[completion]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]'' requires the completion of numerous tasks, all of which are listed below, along with links to pages explaining the tasks and how to complete them. Unlike the other games, ''GTA San Andreas'' has extra tasks that are not required for the achievement but are also available to complete, many players refers to this as "110%".

==Tasks==
To attain completion in GTA San Andreas, the player must accomplish all of the following:

*Complete all storyline [[Missions in GTA San Andreas|missions]] ([[End of the Line]]).
** Note: it is actually possible to complete the storyline without completing the casino heist strand and the [[Zero RC]] strand, but these missions must be completed as well for 100%. Formatively, the [[Wang Cars]] strand is also optional, but cutscenes in it [[Customs Fast Track #Trivia|make a direct reference]] to the main storyline, thereby deeming it conceptually compulsory to play the strand for continuity.
*Learn all new moves from the three [[gyms]].
*Complete all [[vehicles|vehicle]] challenges.
**[[Chiliad Challenge]]
**[[BMX Challenge]]
**[[NRG-500 Challenge]]
*Complete all [[assets|asset]] [[missions]].
**[[Trucking]] [[missions]]
**[[Roboi's Food Mart]] [[Roboi's Food Mart Courier Mission|courier]] [[missions|mission]]
**[[Hippy Shopper]]'s [[Courier Missions in GTA San Andreas|courier mission]]
**[[Burger Shot]]'s [[Courier Missions in GTA San Andreas|courier missions]]
**[[Valet Parking]]
**[[Hunter Quarry]]'s Quarry missions.
*Complete all odd job [[missions]].
**[[Vigilante]] (level 12)
**[[Paramedic]] (level 12)
**[[Firefighter]] (level 12)
**[[Taxi Driver]] (50 fares)
**[[Pimping (GTA SA)|Pimping]] (level 10)
**[[Freight Train Challenge|Freight Train]] (level 2)
*Complete the [[Ammu-Nation]] [[Ammu-Nation Shooting Range (GTA SA)|shooting range]] (level 12)
*Get all 30 [[Vehicles in GTA San Andreas|vehicles]] to the [[Exports and Imports|Import/Export]] crane.
*Finish all [[Schools in GTA San Andreas|schools]] with at least bronze on each test.
**[[Driving School]]
**[[Learning to Fly|Flight School]]
**[[Bike School]]
**[[Boat School]]
*Purchase all 29 [[Safehouses in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]].
*Finish all [[Stadium Events#GTA San Andreas|stadium events]].
**[[8-Track]]
**[[Kickstart]]
**[[Blood Bowl]]
**[[Dirt Track]]
*Win all [[Race Tournaments in GTA San Andreas|race tournaments]]
*Collect all pickup items.
**50 [[Oysters]]
**100 [[Tags]]
**50 [[Snapshots]]
**50 [[Horseshoes]]

==Rewards==
When completion is achieved in ''San Andreas'', the following rewards are given.
*$1,000,000
*Infinite ammunition
*[[Hydra]] on the roof of [[Sweet|Sweet's]] house.
*[[Rhino]] by the bridge going above [[Ganton]].

==Completionist, 110%==
The following missions are not required for 100% completion, but can be finished:

*[[Beat the Cock!]]; this provides monetary rewards
*[[Beefy Baron]]; this provides mastery over the RC Baron, but may be dropped
*[[Unique Stunt Jumps in GTA San Andreas|Unique Stunt Jumps]]; these increase the bike skills of the player
*[[Burglar|Burglary]]; the infinite sprint obtained after completing this would significantly prevent chances of fatigue or death

Additionally, the following tasks can also be performed:

*Scoring a 100% progress and resulting special outfits from all six girlfriends
*Buying all clothes from all clothing chains
*[[Lowrider Challenge]]
*Finishing with high scores in all arcade games
*Winning atleast one game of Pool
*Furnishing a high score and furthest hoop record in the basketball challenge
*Maximizing all stat skills
*Attaining a "Hitman" skill with all weapons
*Getting money worth $999,999,999
*Acquiring all gang territories and wiping out the Ballas and Vagos
